resources.string: What did the brand\'s page say?
Copy the dates exactly as the brand shows them. This is what the brand says, not a guess by the app.
Choose the status the brand\'s page shows.
Enter a real date as YYYY-MM-DD.
The warranty end cannot be before its start.
The link must be an absolute address starting with http:// or https://.
These are the manufacturer\'s dates, kept separate from the warranty plan you type below. The app never fills them in by itself.
The brand\'s answer is saved together with this device when you tap Save.
